title: Ammonia synthesis reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed reference family for sanity-checking catalyst economics for Haber-Bosch and emerging low-temperature ammonia synthesis. COMET itself remains reaction-agnostic and this family is a screening aid, not a process design.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward selling cost while keeping route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent, higher-confidence pricing and more reproducible routes.

route_templates.name: Oxide-melt fusion of promoted magnetite
preprocess: Magnetite, promoter oxide and carbonate batching
synthesis: Controlled cooling of the fused block
postprocess: Crushing and sieving to 1-2 mm granulate
Careful reduction in syngas to alpha-Fe (or pre-reduction and passivation)
route_templates.route_note: The 1600 C oxide-melt fusion is proxied by the direct-fired continuous kiln, the closest step in the library; a dedicated electric fusion furnace runs hotter than the toller basis, so treat the step cost as a floor.

route_templates.name: Graphitized-carbon Ru with Cs/Ba promotion
preprocess: High-surface graphite heat treatment (graphitization and oxygen etch)
Ruthenium and promoter salt solution make-up
synthesis: Ru deposition onto the treated carbon
postprocess: Hydrogen activation converting promoters to the working state
route_templates.route_note: Support graphitization runs near 1500-2000 C, above the indirect-kiln toller basis used as its proxy; the promoter impregnation chain itself is standard.

route_templates.name: Hydride-fluoride support with Ru CVD
preprocess: CaH2 and fluoride precursor dry blending under inert atmosphere
synthesis: Support solid-solution formation at ~340 C in hydrogen
Ru(acac)3 chemical vapor deposition at 260 C
postprocess: Hydrogen treatment at 340 C to the working state
route_templates.route_note: CVD and air-free hydride handling have no direct step-library analogue; the multistep reactor rate is the closest proxy, so route economics are indicative only.

route_templates.name: Cobalt molybdate nitridation with Cs promotion
preprocess: Ammonium molybdate and cobalt nitrate co-dissolution
Evaporation to the cobalt molybdate precursor
synthesis: Temperature-programmed nitridation in flowing ammonia to Co3Mo3N
postprocess: Passivation and re-activation in synthesis gas
route_templates.route_note: The ammonia-flow nitridation is proxied by the indirect kiln, which understates the dedicated TPN furnace; treat the step cost as a floor.

candidates.title: Promoted fused-iron (magnetite/wustite) baseline
candidates.summary: The century-old Haber-Bosch workhorse: fused Fe3O4 (or wustite Fe1-xO) with a few percent of K2O, Al2O3 and CaO promoters, reduced in situ to alpha-Fe and run at 400-500 C and 100-300 bar.
decision_notes: Cheapest active metal in the family and a fully de-risked manufacturing chain; the cost of ownership sits in compression duty, not the catalyst.
Wustite variants trade the same formulation for ~70% higher activity, so the screen's iron term is conservative.

pricing.note: Contained-Fe cost from bulk synthetic black iron oxide (ICIS 2006, $0.94/lb, CatCost library), ChemPPI-escalated. The scrap-iron market feed understates precursor chemistry ~40x, so Fe components price on a precursor basis.
2025 USGS alumina import value; structural promoter loading from the commercial composition table. Alumina is the structural promoter of the fused formulation, carried in the support role.
2025e f.o.b. mine muriate-of-potash price, $600/t of K2O equivalent (USGS MCS Feb 2026); introduced industrially as potassium nitrate, so this is a floor.
Quicklime, magnesia and silica minors at ~2 wt% combined; commodity oxides priced as a package because the term is immaterial to the screen.

candidates.title: Cs/Ba-promoted Ru on graphitized carbon (KAAP-type)
candidates.summary: About 8 wt% Ru with cesium and barium promoters on graphitized high-surface carbon runs milder loops (370-400 C, 50-100 bar) with 40-50% per-pass yields at a large precious-metal premium.
decision_notes: Commercially proven since the 1990s; choose it when milder loop pressure is worth the Ru inventory.
Promoter loadings are not disclosed in the open literature, so the Cs-Ba package weight is a screening assumption priced at cesium parity (conservative, barium is far cheaper).

pricing.note: Live Ru feed with a precursor conversion markup; loading of ca 8 wt% is source-quoted for the commercial KAAP catalyst.

Sigma 441902 cesium carbonate 500 g list $312 = $0.765/g contained Cs = $346.94/lb; package weight is a screening assumption (loadings undisclosed) priced at Cs parity, which is conservative because barium salts are far cheaper. USGS MCS 2026 states no commercial bulk cesium market exists.

Graphitized high-surface carbon support. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg; the 1770-2270 K graphitization premium sits on top of the commodity floor. Bulk conductive/acetylene battery grades cluster at $5,000-7,000/t in marketplace offers (MOQ 1-2 t), the tier between rubber grade and lab retail.

candidates.title: Ru/CaFH low-temperature architecture
candidates.summary: 12 wt% Ru on a CaF2-CaH2 solid solution synthesizes ammonia from as low as 50 C (Ea ~20 kJ/mol), pointing at electrolysis-coupled low-pressure loops, but the air-free CVD manufacturing chain is lab-bound.
decision_notes: Family performance ceiling for low-temperature operation; screen it to bound what the emerging class could cost, not as a procurement option.
Support economics are the dominant unknown: CaH2-grade hydride chemistry has no public bulk market.

pricing.note: Live Ru feed with a higher markup for the Ru(acac)3 CVD precursor route; 12 wt% loading is source-quoted.
CaF2-CaH2 solid solution has no public bulk market; the proxy spans fluorspar commodity economics and calcium-hydride reagent pricing and should be treated as indicative only.

candidates.title: Cs-promoted Co3Mo3N nitride
candidates.summary: The interpolation-designed ternary nitride: bulk Co3Mo3N with a cesium promoter, reported around three times the commercial-iron rate at 673 K and atmospheric test pressure.
decision_notes: The only non-Fe, non-Ru chemistry in the family; molybdenum inventory dominates the material term.
The 3x-Fe rate figure comes from literature excerpts quoting the primary papers, not from an abstract read directly - treat as indicative.

pricing.note: Contained-molybdenum basis of the Co3Mo3N stoichiometry (60.1 wt% Mo) with a mild precursor markup.
Contained-cobalt basis of the Co3Mo3N stoichiometry (36.9 wt% Co).
Sigma 441902 cesium carbonate 500 g list $312 = $0.765/g contained Cs = $346.94/lb. USGS MCS 2026 states no commercial bulk cesium market exists.
